question: What minimal awareness enables people to act according to this view?
premises: Desire or activity arises only when some capability is present.
People notice their own agency, even slightly.
This slight awareness supports their continual engagement in action.
inference: A minimal recognition of one's own agency is sufficient to initiate ordinary activity.
plain_english: When there is capability, desire may arise for activity; therefore people, having slightly noticed their own agency, always engage in action.
